fighter.name: Kael
fighter.weapon: Niten Ichi-ryu — long katana + short wakizashi

status: PROPOSED — art not generated, not approved, not packed. Timing below is the wiring target, not a measurement of a live move.

units.frames: 60 Hz game time; the existing COMBAT_TEMPO 1.2 accelerates playback and the cinematic hitstop crawl still applies
units.rect_origin: center-feet: x is forward, y is up, y names the rectangle's BOTTOM edge, all in world pixels
units.note: Runtime rectangles are top-left origin with y down; the packer converts. Kael's idle stands 120 world px tall — every number below is a fraction of that, not an absolute picked out of the air.

timing.comment: Heavy tier baseline in web/index.html:2069 is startup 0.42 / active 0.07 seconds, scaled by the fighter's own recovery divisor. 5/5/6 at 60 Hz sits on that baseline. A jump-in is committed: it does not cancel, and landing before recovery ends still pays the landing tail.

properties.cancel_comment: No cancels. Existing heavy whiff commitment is preserved; this move must stay punishable on block and on whiff.

velocity.comment: the jump's own arc; the move adds nothing yet
he tips forward and starts to fall; the plunge is a nudge, not a dive-bomb

hitbox.comment: the contact frame. Reach 74 px forward is 0.62 of his 120 px body — a committed jump-in, shorter than his ground forward Heavy.
the arc has swept down; the box follows the tips below his feet line
last eligible sample; the box expires with this exposure

frames.comment: hands off to ajump5 / fall without a jump-cut

wiring.why: web/index.html:13239 already reads `F.airhfwd1 !== undefined ? 'airhfwd' : 'hfwd'` and gives the forward case its own `airheavy` animation track. Packing the row under this key makes it live.

sheet.manifest: web/assets/sprites/kael.json — add airhfwd1..8 to `frames`, set `cols` to 319, change nothing else
sheet.sheet_v: bump SHEET_V in web/index.html in the SAME commit as the sprite change

verification_after_packing: python3 tools/check_sheets_whole.py --worktree — nine sheets whole, every original cell byte-identical
SHADOWCLASH_URL=http://localhost:9101/index.html python3 tools/audit_move_coverage.py --ids 5 — Kael's air distinct count must rise from 8/20, and air fwd+H must stop echoing neutral+H
node tools/check_dir_moves.mjs — every track matches its cell count, every art row exists

python3 tools/export_footsies_frames.py --fighter 5 --move heavy --direction forward --facing 1 --scenario hit --frames 20 --out media/kael-airhfwd/right — plus facing -1, and scenario whiff and block
Consecutive live-loop filmstrip of the airborne forward Heavy in BOTH facings — watched, not asserted. Cel animation cuts; a static assert cannot see a ghost.
